reasons.claim: The first route runs from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti through Abd al-Karim ibn Amr al-Khath'ami and Zurara to Abu Ja'far.
reasons.quote: وَ رَوَى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ اَلْبَزَنْطِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْكَرِيمِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو اَلْخَثْعَمِيِّ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ

reasons.claim: After the first chain reaches Abu Ja'far, a second route opens with Musa ibn Bakr through Zurara to Abu Ja'far.
reasons.quote: وَ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:

reasons.claim: The closing note records extra wording in Abd al-Karim's narration rather than a new route.
reasons.quote: وَ زَادَ عَبْدُ اَلْكَرِيمِ فِي حَدِيثِهِ

reviews.uncertainty_note: The genitive vocalization in «مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ» could also allow reading Musa ibn Bakr as conjoined under Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti rather than as a second independent route.
